property_summary: For any caller and amount satisfying Acc[caller].balance >= MinSum, Acc[caller].balance >= amount, and block.timestamp > Acc[caller].unlockTime, a single call to Collect(amount) on the correct contract always decreases Acc[caller].balance by exactly amount (no reentrant extra drains), whereas the mutant that moves the subtraction after the external call can be reentered to withdraw more and thus can leave Acc[caller].balance decreased by more than amount for some inputs.
change_summary: Move the account balance subtraction from after the external call to before the .call, so acc.balance is reduced before transferring funds (changes reentrancy-visible state timing).
